newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria hands over rescued Chad officials.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria hands over rescued Chad officials.

text.p: Nigeria has handed over to Chad four officials of that country captured by Chadian rebels, the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reported on Friday.
The handover took place in Maidugari, northeastern Nigeria, where the two countries have a common border.
NAN named the officials as Mohammed Mboin, Ismail Adam Mustapha, Dumba Mohammed and Abba Kura Mohammed and said they were rescued by Nigeria's government but gave no other details.
Chadian rebels frequently operate around the border area.
